One image, wide 3:1 landscape, ideally 3840x1280 pixels, solid white background.

MOST IMPORTANT STYLE REQUIREMENTS:

Avoid pure red, bright green, bright blue, neon yellow.

Large middle enclosure 'Single RACE-RL Agent': on left 'Relational Encoder' with a heterogeneous directed graph, on right 'Joint Actor' with an aligned multilayer neural graph. A rightward arrow between them. A restrained 'REINFORCE' label underneath, on white.

Forward path State -> Single Agent -> Complete Action -> Environment.
Top 'Reward' feedback from Environment back into TOP of the SINGLE agent, arrowhead at agent.
Bottom 'Next State' feedback from Environment back into BOTTOM of State, arrowhead at State.
Keep a comfortable white perimeter, especially above Reward and below Next State, no clipped text.

DO NOT ALTER SCIENCE: exactly one agent and one completed action before environment evaluation. Do not add models, method names, explanation paragraphs, equations, axes, numerical performance results, fault crosses, distillation, PPO, DQN, critic, teacher/student, second DRAM or memory chiplets. Neural/node counts, chiplet count and bar levels remain illustrative. Improve STYLE, not functionality. Critical success criterion is a sophisticated low-saturation MATTE scientific figure, with image-based explanation and minimal text.
scope: Retain the same modules, labels, conceptual data paths, single-agent REINFORCE algorithm, complete-action boundary, reward/state feedback and illustrative hardware. Change only visual styling, line weight, palette, alignment and illustrative detail.
interpretation: Academic conceptual illustration, not a physical layout, literal neural-layer topology or measured PPA. Four chiplets and the indicator bar levels remain illustrative; the RL compute-count action range is 1–16.
